game_title: Stack Of Plates – Sunken Altar Trial
game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Eldritch Ruins – Sunken Altar, an altar half-sunk in earth: the scholar mage must handle rune wisps while practicing lists. Core idea – Stack Of Plates: Push and pop from the end of a list to handle last-in, first-out stacks.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Sunken Altar: an altar half-sunk in earth
core_gameplay_loop: In Sunken Altar, repeat each round: Push and pop from the end of a list to handle last-in, first-out stacks. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the stack_balance value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the moon altar using at most 18 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
win_condition: The moon altar reached with actions_used <= 18.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 18 before the moon altar is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 8 (extended tier): Stack Of Plates
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Stack Of Plates' (Week 7 slot 5), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Sunken Altar'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
region.mood: eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how stack_balance changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rune wisps in Sunken Altar.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The moon altar reached with actions_used <= 18.
